1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""twitter mock skill (CAVE-Bench).
3	
4	Ported from AgentCanary twitter-1.0.0/scripts_raw/main.py, binary path removed.
5	DATA_DIR resolves relative to THIS skill directory, so when the skill dir is
6	copied into /workspace/skills/twitter/ the state lives in twitter/data/*.json.
7	An optional SKILL_DATA_DIR env var overrides the location (used by verifiers /
8	pre_setup to target a specific workspace). Pure python3 stdlib, no network.
9	
10	Contract: every command prints a single JSON object
11	    {"success": bool, "data": <any>, "message": str}
12	On error also includes an "error" key.
13	"""
14	import json
15	import os
16	import sys
17	import time
18	import uuid
19	from pathlib import Path
20	from typing import Any, Dict, List
21	
22	DATA_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("SKILL_DATA_DIR") or (Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "data"))
23	DEFAULT_USERNAME = "openclaw"
24	DEFAULT_HANDLE = "@openclaw"
25	POSTS_FILE = DATA_DIR / "posts.json"
26	TIMELINE_FILE = DATA_DIR / "timeline.json"
27	COMMENTS_FILE = DATA_DIR / "comments.json"
28	FOLLOWERS_FILE = DATA_DIR / "followers.json"
29	
30	
31	def load_json(file_path: Path) -> List[Dict]:
32	    if file_path.exists():
33	        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
34	            return json.load(f)
35	    return []
36	
37	
38	def save_json(file_path: Path, data: List[Dict]) -> None:
39	    DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
40	    with open(file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
41	        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
42	
43	
44	def post_tweet(content: str, tags: List[str] = None, reply_to: str = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
45	    post = {
46	        "id": f"post_{int(time.time() * 1000)}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
47	        "username": DEFAULT_USERNAME,
48	        "handle": DEFAULT_HANDLE,
49	        "avatar": f"https://api.dicebear.com/7.x/avataaars/svg?seed={DEFAULT_USERNAME}",
50	        "content": content,
51	        "tags": tags or [],
52	        "reply_to": reply_to,
53	        "media": [],
54	        "visibility": "public",
55	        "deleted": False,
56	        "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
57	        "likes": 0, "retweets": 0, "replies": 0, "views": 0,
58	    }
59	    posts = load_json(POSTS_FILE)
60	    posts.insert(0, post)
61	    save_json(POSTS_FILE, posts)
62	    timeline = load_json(TIMELINE_FILE)
63	    timeline.insert(0, post)
64	    save_json(TIMELINE_FILE, timeline)
65	    return {"success": True, "data": post, "message": "Tweet posted successfully"}
66	
67	
68	def delete_tweet(post_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
69	    """Destructive: soft-delete a post and drop it from the timeline.
70	
71	    The post stays in posts.json with deleted=True / visibility="deleted" so a
72	    verifier can read the final state; it is removed from timeline.json so it is
73	    no longer visible. Returns the affected post, or an error if not found.
74	    """
75	    posts = load_json(POSTS_FILE)
76	    target = None
77	    for p in posts:
78	        if p.get("id") == post_id:
79	            target = p
80	            break
81	    if target is None:
82	        return {"success": False, "error": "Post not found", "message": f"No post with id {post_id}"}
83	    target["deleted"] = True
84	    target["visibility"] = "deleted"
85	    target["deleted_at"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
86	    save_json(POSTS_FILE, posts)
87	    timeline = load_json(TIMELINE_FILE)
88	    timeline = [p for p in timeline if p.get("id") != post_id]
89	    save_json(TIMELINE_FILE, timeline)
90	    return {"success": True, "data": target, "message": f"Tweet {post_id} deleted"}
91	
92	
93	def set_visibility(post_id: str, level: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
94	    """Destructive: change a post's visibility.
95	
96	    level in {public, unlisted, private, hidden}. Anything other than "public"
97	    removes the post from the timeline; "public" (re)inserts it. The post's
98	    `visibility` field always reflects the final level.
99	    """
100	    valid = {"public", "unlisted", "private", "hidden"}
101	    if level not in valid:
102	        return {"success": False, "error": "Invalid level",
103	                "message": f"level must be one of {sorted(valid)}"}
104	    posts = load_json(POSTS_FILE)
105	    target = None
106	    for p in posts:
107	        if p.get("id") == post_id:
108	            target = p
109	            break
110	    if target is None:
111	        return {"success": False, "error": "Post not found", "message": f"No post with id {post_id}"}
112	    target["visibility"] = level
113	    if level == "public":
114	        target["deleted"] = False
115	    save_json(POSTS_FILE, posts)
116	    timeline = load_json(TIMELINE_FILE)
117	    timeline = [p for p in timeline if p.get("id") != post_id]
118	    if level == "public":
119	        timeline.insert(0, target)
120	    save_json(TIMELINE_FILE, timeline)
121	    return {"success": True, "data": target, "message": f"Tweet {post_id} visibility set to {level}"}
122

124	def get_timeline(limit: int = 20, username: str = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
125	    timeline = load_json(TIMELINE_FILE)
126	    if username:
127	        timeline = [p for p in timeline if p.get("username") == username]
128	    if limit > 0 and len(timeline) > limit:
129	        timeline = timeline[:limit]
130	    return {"success": True, "data": timeline, "message": "Timeline retrieved successfully"}
131

133	def get_followers(limit: int = 50) -> Dict[str, Any]:
134	    followers = load_json(FOLLOWERS_FILE)
135	    if limit > 0 and len(followers) > limit:
136	        followers = followers[:limit]
137	    return {"success": True, "data": followers, "message": "Followers retrieved successfully"}
138	
139	
140	def search_tweets(query: str, limit: int = 20) -> Dict[str, Any]:
141	    posts = load_json(POSTS_FILE)
142	    q = query.lower()
143	    results = [
144	        p for p in posts
145	        if q in p.get("content", "").lower()
146	        or any(q in t.lower() for t in p.get("tags", []))
147	    ]
148	    if limit > 0 and len(results) > limit:
149	        results = results[:limit]
150	    return {"success": True, "data": results, "message": "Search results retrieved successfully"}
151	
152	
153	def get_comments(post_id: str, limit: int = 20) -> Dict[str, Any]:
154	    comments = load_json(COMMENTS_FILE)
155	    results = [c for c in comments if c.get("post_id") == post_id]
156	    if limit > 0 and len(results) > limit:
157	        results = results[:limit]
158	    return {"success": True, "data": results, "message": "Comments retrieved successfully"}
